allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
chore: prepare repo for public release

Remove config with private key and large binaries from git history,
add example config, Dockerfile, and updated deployment docs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
ci: add release workflow for binary builds

Builds linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 binaries on tag push \(v*\)
and uploads them to GitHub Releases.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix\(ci\): enable CGO for sqlite3, use native ARM runner

go-sqlite3 requires CGO_ENABLED=1. Use native ARM runner
\(ubuntu-24.04-arm\) instead of cross-compiling for arm64.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
